fields.label: Laugh
fields.description: How likely a human reader is to actually laugh, not merely admire the idea.

fields.label: Surprise
fields.description: Whether the turn avoids the obvious route and lands with a satisfying snap.

fields.label: Craft
fields.description: Economy, stage rhythm, first-person clarity, escalation, and clean final punchline placement.

fields.label: Originality
fields.description: Freshness of comic angle, image, and wording.

fields.label: Prompt Fit
fields.description: Natural first-person stand-up form using exactly two seed terms, with the other four left out.

anchors.label: Broken
anchors.description: Not a joke, incoherent, unsafe, or unusable.

anchors.label: Weak
anchors.description: Recognizably attempting humor, but generic, strained, or confusing.

anchors.label: Competent
anchors.description: Clear and publishable as filler, but unlikely to earn a real laugh.

anchors.label: Amusing
anchors.description: A real comic idea with a mild payoff.

anchors.label: Good
anchors.description: Would fit a curated humor page; most readers can see why it is funny.

anchors.label: Excellent
anchors.description: Strong human-level joke with a memorable turn and clean construction.

anchors.label: Outstanding
anchors.description: Rare, replayable, and clearly better than normal good AI humor.

anchors.label: Classic
anchors.description: Reserve for a joke a human would quote later; most contests should have none.

jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.model: dry, compact, understated jokes with a hard final turn
jokes.title: Immersive Salad
jokes.joke: I got hired as a Food Critic for a Greenhouse, which is a tough gig because every review is basically, "The salad was immersive, but the service kept photosynthesizing." I gave one star to a fern and it still had better posture than me.

jokes.label: Joke B

jokes.title: Group Session
jokes.joke: I tried Herding a bunch of Macho guys into therapy. They refused to talk about feelings, but formed a perfect single-file line behind the first dude who said, "I'm not angry, my eyebrows are just doing CrossFit."

jokes.title: Growth Potential
jokes.joke: I went on a date at a Greenhouse because she said she liked someone Obedient. I spent forty minutes nodding at plant care instructions before realizing she brought me there to meet someone with more growth potential.

jokes.joke: I tried being an Obedient Food Critic. The chef said, "Be honest," so I said, "Yes, chef, this steak is aggressively medium and I apologize for noticing."

jokes.title: Leadership Exercise
jokes.joke: I went to a Macho leadership seminar where the team-building exercise was Herding. Nothing humbles alpha males faster than watching six guys in wraparound sunglasses lose a staring contest to one goat with tenure.
